onboarding.title: Welcome to KoalaCast
onboarding.intro: Select the languages you speak and your favorite topics. We'll tailor your Discover feed without tracking you — everything stays on your device.

discover.title: Discover & Listen to Podcasts
discover.subtitle: Stream shows directly from creators. Simple, calm, privacy-first audio playback.
discover.searchPlaceholder: Search podcasts by title, author, or topic…
discover.noResults: No podcasts found matching "{query}". Try another search term!
discover.noResultsInLanguages: No podcasts found in your languages. Add another language in Settings to widen your feed.
discover.subscribeError: Could not subscribe. Please try again.
discover.confirmHidePodcast: Hide {title} from Discover and Search? You can bring it back in Settings.
discover.podcastHidden: {title} is hidden from Discover and Search.
discover.openError: This podcast feed could not be opened. Try searching for another source.

search.title: Search podcasts
search.placeholder: Search millions of shows by title, author, or topic…
search.filterHint: Pre-set from your settings. Clear them to search all languages.
search.addByRss: Add a podcast by RSS URL
search.startHint: Search by title, person, or topic, or add a show directly by RSS URL.
search.noResults: No podcasts found for “{query}”. Try another term or add the show by RSS URL.

library.title: Library
library.subtitle: Your shows, in-progress episodes and queue — all on this device.
library.emptySubscriptions: You haven't subscribed to any podcasts yet.
library.emptyInProgress: Nothing in progress yet. Start an episode and it'll show up here.
library.emptyQueue: Your queue is empty. Add episodes from any show to line them up.
library.emptyFavorites: No favorites yet. Tap the heart on an episode to save it here.
library.namedQueuesHint: Save this running order and restore it later.
library.folderPrompt: Folder for {title}. Leave empty to remove it from a folder.
library.playLatestUnheard: Play the latest unplayed episode of {title}
library.noUnplayedEpisodes: No unplayed episode is available for this podcast.
library.playEpisodeError: The latest unplayed episode could not be loaded.
library.smartQueuesHint: A saved set of rules, not a saved list — the answer is recomputed every time you open this.
library.smartQueueNoMatches: Nothing matches these rules right now.

inbox.title: New
inbox.subtitle: Latest episodes from the shows you follow.
inbox.panelHint: Choose how much each show contributes. Pick {mode} for hourly news shows so they don't flood your feed.
inbox.emptyNoSubscriptions: Subscribe to some shows and their newest episodes land here.
inbox.emptyCaughtUp: You're all caught up — nothing unplayed.

profileStats.title: Your listening
profileStats.trackingStarts: Tracking starts with your next play
profileStats.emptyBody: Play any episode to begin private listening statistics. Patterns and rankings appear only after there is meaningful data.
profileStats.averageHint: On days you listened at all
profileStats.activityLabel: Listening activity over the last 26 weeks
profileStats.rankingEmpty: Your rankings appear after you listen to a show.
profileStats.baseline: Baseline: playing everything at 1× in full
profileStats.coverage: You covered {audio} of audio in {time} of real time.
profileStats.trimSilenceHint: Measured while silence trimming is active
profileStats.savedSummary: Average speed {speed}× · {percent}% of baseline skipped · measured locally
profileStats.syncBody: Listening sessions sync to your signed-in KoalaCast account so your statistics follow you across devices.
profileStats.localBody: Sign in to synchronize listening sessions across your devices. No third-party analytics receive this data.

settings.title: Settings
settings.appearanceHint: Select your preferred color theme or automatically follow your operating system settings.
settings.colorPaletteHint: Choose the atmosphere. Every palette works in light and dark mode.
settings.newPodcastEpisodesHint: Default for podcasts you subscribe to from now on. You can still override individual shows in New.
settings.playbackHint: Audio processing preferences are stored in this browser and apply to every episode.
settings.volumeBoostHint: Raises quiet sources with gain and compression. Availability depends on the podcast host allowing browser audio processing.
settings.skipSilenceHint: Speeds through sustained quiet sections while preserving short, natural speech pauses.
settings.startScreenHint: Screen opened once when KoalaCast starts in a new browser session.
settings.visualizerHint: Show a lightweight live signal while audio is playing.
settings.downloadsHint: Shared defaults for automatic episode downloads.
settings.wifiOnlyHint: Prevent automatic downloads over metered mobile connections.
settings.parallelDownloadsHint: Maximum downloads running at the same time.
settings.autoDownloadCountHint: How many recent episodes automatic download keeps ready.
settings.downloadRetentionHint: When downloaded episodes may be removed.
settings.downloadPolicyPlatformHint: This policy controls the Android app. Browser downloads remain explicit and use browser-managed storage.
settings.proxyImages: Protect IP address when loading artwork
settings.proxyImagesHint: Load remote covers through the KoalaCast image proxy. Turning this off contacts podcast image hosts directly.
settings.interfaceLanguageHint: The language KoalaCast itself is displayed in.
settings.contentLanguagesHint: Discover and Search only show podcasts spoken in these languages. At least one must stay selected.
settings.interestsHint: Tap once to prefer a genre (shown in "For You"), tap again to hide it everywhere, tap a third time to reset. Stays on your device.
settings.hiddenPodcastsHint: Shows you hid are removed from Discover and Search.
settings.helpTranslate: KoalaCast is translated by its community. Missing your language, or spotted a wrong word?
settings.subtitle: Appearance, privacy, import/export and your optional sync account.
settings.confirmReset: Clear all local browser subscriptions and listening history? This action cannot be undone.
settings.opmlReadError: Error reading or processing OPML XML file.
settings.opmlNothingToExport: No subscriptions with a feed URL to export yet.
settings.privacyBody: Your subscriptions, queue, and listening history stay in this browser. KoalaCast contacts the server to search podcasts and retrieve RSS metadata, but anonymous listening activity is not stored on the server.
settings.privacyBodySignedIn: You are signed in: subscriptions, favorites, queue, playback progress, settings, and listening sessions sync through your KoalaCast server. Global publication remains off unless you separately opt in below.
settings.opmlHint: Import subscriptions from Pocket Casts, Apple Podcasts, AntennaPod, or Overcast XML files.
settings.signInPrompt: Sign in or register an account to sync subscriptions, favorites, playback progress, and listening statistics across all your devices.
settings.globalStatsOptInBody: Optional: include your listening sessions in anonymous site-wide aggregates and show {username} in the listener leaderboard. No episodes, timestamps, or raw sessions are published.
settings.globalStatsSignIn: Sign in to voluntarily join the global aggregates and listener leaderboard.
settings.globalStatsSaveError: The global statistics preference could not be saved.
settings.syncDescription: Subscriptions, progress, and listening statistics sync automatically across your devices.
settings.opmlTooLarge: The OPML file is larger than 5 MB.
settings.opmlNoFeeds: This OPML file contains no feeds.
settings.installAppHint: Opens KoalaCast in its own window, with media keys and offline access.
settings.opmlBackupHint: Choose a file once; KoalaCast keeps it up to date with your subscriptions.

globalStats.title: Global listening
globalStats.subtitle: Anonymous aggregates and voluntary community rankings from participating KoalaCast accounts.
globalStats.noData: No opted-in listening data exists for this range yet.
globalStats.loadError: Global statistics could not be loaded.
globalStats.errorHint: You may be offline or the server may be temporarily unavailable. No local listening data was lost.
globalStats.cachedData: Offline view: showing the last successfully loaded global statistics.
globalStats.privacy: Only accounts with the voluntary setting enabled are included. Turning it off removes the account from these aggregates and rankings immediately.

account.title: Account Overview
account.subtitle: Manage your account profile, device sessions, and cloud synchronization.
account.dataControlHint: Download everything stored for this account, or delete the account for good.
account.deleteWarning: This deletes your account and every synchronized record on the server. It cannot be undone.
account.deleteCredentialLabel: Confirm with your password or a recovery code
account.deleteConfirm: Permanently delete this account and all of its data?
account.deleteDone: Your account and its data have been deleted.
account.deleteFailed: The account could not be deleted. Please try again.
account.deleteInvalidCredential: That password or recovery code is not correct.

login.metaDescription: Sign in to your KoalaCast account to synchronize your podcast subscriptions and listening progress across devices.
login.title: Sign In
login.subtitle: Access your account to sync subscriptions and queue across all your devices.
login.missingCredentials: Please enter both your username and your password.
login.networkError: Could not reach the server. Check your connection and try again.
login.failed: Sign-in failed. Please check your username and password.

recover.title: Recover account
recover.subtitle: Use the recovery code you saved when creating your account. All existing sessions will be signed out.
recover.saveCode: Save this new recovery code now. The previous code no longer works.
recover.error: The account could not be recovered.

register.metaDescription: Create a new KoalaCast account to enable seamless cloud synchronization.
register.title: Create Account
register.subtitle: Create a KoalaCast account to sync your subscriptions across devices.
register.createdSubtitle: Please save your one-time account recovery code. You will need it if you ever lose your password.
register.missingCredentials: Enter both a username and password.
